title: Payments queue links for restaurant orders / reservations open the 'กำลังพัฒนาในเฟสถัดไป' placeholder (no such admin route); table-bill payments show a raw id instead of a number
where: packages/modules/commerce/src/admin/payments.ts:32-48 (refHrefFor) + refNumbers() lines 50-63; admin has no app/t/[slug]/restaurant/orders/[id] or restaurant/reservations/[id] route, so [...rest]/page.tsx placeholder renders
steps: Login admin -> /t/demo-restaurant/payments?tab=paid -> click 'เปิดรายการ' or the number on any 'ออเดอร์ร้านอาหาร' row
expected: Opens the restaurant order (or board filtered to it) / the reservation day; table-bill (session) payments show the table/session or the order numbers
actual: Navigates to /t/demo-restaurant/restaurant/orders/<uuid> which renders the module placeholder 'ส่วนนี้อยู่ระหว่างการพัฒนา / กำลังพัฒนาในเฟสถัดไป'. Same for refType reservation (/restaurant/reservations/<id>). Session-bill payments (refType rest_order, refId = table_session id from services/tables.ts:166) show '01a14028' instead of a number because refNumbers only looks up restaurant_orders.id.
evidence: qa/bughunt/admin_modules-x1.ts output: 'follow /t/demo-restaurant/restaurant/orders/01a144bd-ffab-706d-9554-138f42173c7f -> 200 h1= ออเดอร์ร้าน | ... ส่วนนี้อยู่ระหว่างการพัฒนา กำลังพัฒนาในเฟสถัดไป'; rows '฿1,200 ชำระแล้ว ออเดอร์ร้านอาหาร พร้อมเพย์ QR 01a14028' (no R- number); screenshot tooling/screenshots/bughunt-admin_modules-payments-restaurant-link.png
suggestedFix: Point rest_order to `/restaurant/orders?focus=<id>` (board) or add a restaurant order detail route; reservation to `/restaurant/reservations?date=<yyyy-mm-dd>`; for metadata.kind === 'session' resolve the table name/session orders.

title: Restaurant tenant dashboard has no KPIs and tells the owner to 'enable a module' although the restaurant module is on
expected: Restaurant KPIs (orders today / revenue today / reservations today / slips waiting), checklist 'เพิ่มรายการจริง' pointing to the menu
actual: KPI row shows only 'ลูกค้าใหม่ 7 วัน 6' and a card 'ยอดขายวันนี้ — เปิดโมดูลร้านค้า จองคิว หรือเติมเกมเพื่อดูยอด' even though demo-restaurant had 9 paid restaurant orders today; the checklist 'content' item links to /pages and realItem never counts menu items.
evidence: qa/bughunt/admin_modules-x1.ts output: '== demo-restaurant dashboard KPIs: ลูกค้าใหม่ 7 วัน 6 ยอดขายวันนี้ — เปิดโมดูลร้านค้า จองคิว หรือเติมเกมเพื่อดูยอด'; payments?tab=paid lists 9 rest_order payments dated 16 ต.ค. 2569
suggestedFix: Add a hasRestaurant branch (restaurant_orders today / paid revenue, reservations today, pending slips) and count menu_items for realItem; link checklist to /restaurant/menu.

title: restaurant-admin-journey step 7b always fails: it waits for a toast matching /หมด|บันทึก|กลับมา/ but the action replies 'เปิดขายอีกครั้งแล้ว' (product behaviour is correct)
where: tooling/qa/restaurant-admin-journey.ts:284 vs apps/admin/src/app/t/[slug]/restaurant/menu/actions.ts:158 (message 'เปิดขายอีกครั้งแล้ว')
expected: 14+1 steps pass when the feature works
actual: FAIL 7b menu: toggle back -> storefront sells it again — locator('[data-sonner-toast]').filter({ hasText: /หมด|บันทึก|กลับมา/ }) not found; the switch did flip (aria-checked=false passed) and DB/storefront are correct

title: Printed shipping label (ใบปะหน้า) drops the sender block and the order number/date: the print CSS hides every <header>, including the label's own header
where: apps/admin/src/app/t/[slug]/orders/[id]/print/page.tsx:31 (`@media print { aside, header, [data-print-hide] ... { display:none } }`) + :39 (<header> inside .print-sheet holding 'ผู้ส่ง', shop name/address/phone, order number, placed date)
steps: Admin -> /t/demo-shop/orders/<#1044 id>/print -> Ctrl+P (or Playwright emulateMedia print / page.pdf)
expected: Label prints sender (shop name, address, phone) and order number + date above the recipient box
actual: In print media the .print-sheet <header> is display:none -> the printed label starts at 'ผู้รับ'; no sender and no order number. Same at 390px width.
evidence: qa/bughunt/admin_modules-print.ts output: order print @1440: {"sheetHeader":"HIDDEN","sender":"HIDDEN","orderNo":"#104416",...}; screenshot tooling/screenshots/bughunt-admin_modules-print-order-1440.png and PDF tooling/screenshots/bughunt-admin_modules-print-order.pdf show only ผู้รับ/การจัดส่ง/items
suggestedFix: Scope the rule to the app chrome (e.g. `body > div header:not(.print-sheet header)` or mark the shell header with data-print-hide) or change the sheet's <header> to a <div>.
